title: Extension manifest
description: Structure of extension.yaml — declared at the root of a third-party extension repository so `aiadev extension add` can validate it before registering.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case identifier; the extension is cloned to ~/.aiadev/extensions/<name>/.

version.description: Semver. The framework also stamps a git-resolved version (`git describe --tags --always`) into the registry; this field is informational.

presets.description: Names of preset directories under the extension's `presets/` tree. Each must contain a valid preset.yaml.
